name: What is the typical process for getting a foreclosed property painted by City Dweller, LLC?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for getting a foreclosed property painted by City Dweller, LLC?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with an initial consultation and on-site evaluation of the foreclosed property to assess its condition and specific painting needs. We then provide a detailed, itemized estimate. Once approved, our team schedules the work, handles all necessary surface preparation, performs the painting, and conducts a thorough cleanup. We prioritize clear communication throughout the project to ensure satisfaction and a timely completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our process involves an on-site evaluation, a detailed estimate, scheduling, surface preparation, painting, and a final cleanup, with clear communication throughout.
